notes.title: Patch v1.4.0 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][b]Expeditioners, [/b][/p][p]
Patch v1.4.0 is now LIVE![/p][p][/p][p]We’re SUPER excited to bring you the Battle Retry option in this update, which has been one of our most requested QoL additions! We’re also thrilled to have added Frame Generation and Low Latency on compatible NVIDIA and Intel GPUs. We are still exploring support for FSR, but we need more time to work on it. Stay tuned for more updates on that in a future patch![/p][p][/p][p]Take a look at the biggest changes in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Performance & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]DLSS & XeSS Enhancements: Added Frame Generation and Low Latency Mode support for both DLSS and XeSS (compatible GPUs only). Enjoy smoother gameplay and lower input lag!
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Battle Retry Prompt: A new pop-up window appears after defeat, giving you the option to quickly retry the battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Lumina Cost Display: The Pictos menu now clearly displays the Lumina cost of each ability for better planning.[/p][/*][*][p]Autoplay Dialogue: Added an optional autoplay feature for dialogues outside cutscenes. You can toggle it in the settings and during dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Separate Volume Sliders: Audio settings now lets you independently adjust the volume for exploration and combat phases.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Accessibility[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added icons to Lune’s Stains to improve readability and accessibility for colorblind players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Combat[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lune's "Thermal Transfer" skill will no longer grant an extra turn without meeting the Stain consumption requirements[/p][/*][*][p]Characters will no longer gain immortality when using the Second Chance pictos combined with Healing Boon and Protecting Death [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Misc[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Rocher holding a crystal occasionally despawning after reentering the Stone Wave Cliffs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some players being teleported behind the Monolith upon loading a save [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Gameplay modifiers being applied to a New Game save when enabled on other saves [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed landing as Esquie without the party spawning, leading to input loss [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Fog on Flying Manor covering the screen and blocking the view on Steam Deck [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Achievements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed journals vanishing after loading a Save File that was created at the exact moment of picking up that journal [/p][/*][/list][p][i]The following two trophies should now pop for you when you load your save if you were effected by these bugs:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed "Expeditioner" and "Trailbreaker" achievements not unlocking if the characters reach a level higher than 33 or 66 after a battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed  'Connoisseur' and 'Follow The Trail' achievements not unlocking after collecting all required items on some savefiles [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Environmental Polish[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various environmental bugfixes, tweaks and visual polish across multiple levels for a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33! Of course, there is more to come in the future…[/p][p][/p][p]Until then, [/p][p][/p][p]Tomorrow comes!

~ The Expedition 33 Team [/p][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: We’re SUPER excited to bring you the Battle Retry option in this update, which has been one of our most requested QoL additions! We’re also thrilled to have added Frame Generation and Low Latency on compatible NVIDIA and Intel GPUs. We are still exploring support for FSR, but we need more time to work on it. Stay tuned for more updates on that in a future patch!
DLSS & XeSS Enhancements: Added Frame Generation and Low Latency Mode support for both DLSS and XeSS (compatible GPUs only). Enjoy smoother gameplay and lower input lag!
Battle Retry Prompt: A new pop-up window appears after defeat, giving you the option to quickly retry the battle.
Lumina Cost Display: The Pictos menu now clearly displays the Lumina cost of each ability for better planning.
Autoplay Dialogue: Added an optional autoplay feature for dialogues outside cutscenes. You can toggle it in the settings and during dialogues.
Separate Volume Sliders: Audio settings now lets you independently adjust the volume for exploration and combat phases.
Added icons to Lune’s Stains to improve readability and accessibility for colorblind players.

tags.bug: Lune's "Thermal Transfer" skill will no longer grant an extra turn without meeting the Stain consumption requirements
Characters will no longer gain immortality when using the Second Chance pictos combined with Healing Boon and Protecting Death
Fixed the Rocher holding a crystal occasionally despawning after reentering the Stone Wave Cliffs
Fixed some players being teleported behind the Monolith upon loading a save
Fixed Gameplay modifiers being applied to a New Game save when enabled on other saves
Fixed landing as Esquie without the party spawning, leading to input loss
Fixed the Fog on Flying Manor covering the screen and blocking the view on Steam Deck
Fixed journals vanishing after loading a Save File that was created at the exact moment of picking up that journal
Fixed "Expeditioner" and "Trailbreaker" achievements not unlocking if the characters reach a level higher than 33 or 66 after a battle
Fixed  'Connoisseur' and 'Follow The Trail' achievements not unlocking after collecting all required items on some savefiles
Various environmental bugfixes, tweaks and visual polish across multiple levels for a more immersive experience.

notes.title: New Clair Obscur Expedition 33 patch notes give you even more difficulty control
notes.content:
With the newest Clair Obscur Expedition 33 patch notes, Sandfall adjusts the RPG's overall challenge. The story mode difficulty is now easier than ever, helping you jump in and focus on the narrative, while new modifiers allow you to ramp up the toughness of enemies, too. However you like to play, E33's latest update has something for you.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 is LIVE
notes.content:
[p]Expeditioners,[/p][p][/p][p]We have just rolled out a patch, [i]and [/i]uploaded our first ever items to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1903340"]Steam Points Shop![/url] You have some unique Trading Cards to choose from, alongside a series of emoticons. We hope you love them! [/p][p][/p][p]As for the patch, see our notes below where we have called out the most impactful changes.[/p][p][/p][p]Tomorrow comes![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][/h2][p]Note 12:43 CEST - We are investigating Mouse Sensitivity issues following this patch. Stay tuned ![/p][p][/p][h2]Ver 1.3.0 Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Simon Rematch[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now rematch Simon after defeating him![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Story Mode Balancing.[/b][/p][p]Story mode is our easiest difficulty setting.[/p][list][*][p]Parry and dodge windows increased by 40%[/p][/*][*][p]Incoming damage reduced by 10% to 50% [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Challenge Modifiers (Act III onward)[/b]

We hope you enjoy today's changes. notes.title: Patch 1.2.3 is now live!
notes.content:
[h3]Steam Deck
[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed backgrounds of various menus not displaying properly on the Steam Deck
[/list]

[h3]Various Ultrawide Fixes
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gameplay no longer becomes zoomed after a cutscene occurs in ultrawide resolutions
[*]The Options menu image will no longer be stretched in ultrawide resolutions
[*]Combat UI now adapts correctly to ultrawide resolutions
[*]Game will no longer minimize upon changing settings in ultrawide resolution
[*]Cutscenes won’t letterbox in 32:9 aspect ratio
[*]Title screen now displays fullscreen when the game is launched in ultrawide resolution
[/list]
[h3]Mouse and Keyboard
[/h3][list]
[*]UI button prompts in Expedition Menu are now visible and fully able to be triggered with Keyboard
[*]Mouse buttons do not become unresponsive after first use
[*]With mouse cursor on screen, using 'WSAD' or directional arrows to navigate in UI or trigger any other functionality will no longer hide the cursor instead of doing the intended action
[*]Left Mouse-button click will no longer block the player from using Keyboard to navigate menus
[*]Mouse input is not lost after the first Jump counter attack if it is pressed only once
[/list]

[h3]Fixed areas of the world map where you can get stuck:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Between lanterns scattered on the ground near Stone Wave Cliff portal
[*]While walking on the ship wreck near the Forgotten Battlefield level entrance
[*]Between lanterns on the ground near Bourgeon encounter next to Stone Wave Cliffs level
[*]Between two small rocks located between Spring Meadows and Abbest Cave
[*]Between vases and corals when jumping from rooftopps
[*]Between various rocks
[*]In ruins behind Flying Manor level entrance
[*]Near the bridge between Flying Waters and Spring Meadows
[*]In the rocks on the World Map, near Flying Waters
[*]Next to hardened land, close to the Flying Waters location exit
[/list]

[h3]Fixed situations where Esquie specifically would get stuck (poor guy):[/h3]
[list]
[*]When taking off from paint bridges, making him fall through the bridge and restrict movement
[*]When flying into bottom parts of levitating structures near Visages
[*]Near the Flying Waters entrance level
[*]Near a giant hammer when traversing close to Blades' Graveyard level
[/list]

[h3]Weapon and skill fixes and tuning:
[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Lithelim attribute scaling not working at high level. Reduced initial Vitality scaling from A to C (will still end at S at max level). Added Luck scaling starting at D.
[*]Fixed Blizzon attribute scaling not working at high level. Reduced initial Luck scaling from B to C (will still end at S at max level). Added Defense scaling starting at D.
[*]Fixed Medalum third Lumina doubling all damage in Virtuose Stance instead of doubling only Burn damage.
[*]Stendhal: Reduced damage by 40%.[/list]

[h3]Other fixes
[/h3][list]
[*]Boss encounter in Stone Wave Cliffs can now be finished on NG+ 
[*]You will no longer be blocked by the Journal UI window after opening the first Journal in the Spring Meadows
[*]Fixed being unable to shoot in Free aim while exploring levels due to worn triggers
[*]Lune and Monoco no longer spawn in same place during end of theirs Level 6 relationship quests if they are completed without going to camp
[*]If at camp you pick “remember the objective”, then quickly choose to "go to sleep" and immediately after press "leave", the screen no longer goes black 
[*]You can no longer trigger the "Discovering the truth" cutscene in Old Lumière a second time in a row, splitting the party forever.
[*]Update to rolling credits 
[/list]

---

This is the first in a series of patches we are looking to do over the coming months. We are still investigating many feature requests and issues for future updates.

Stay tuned!

~ The Expedition 33 Team

notes.title: Hotfix: NG+ Stonewave Cliffs
notes.content:
We have patched a bug in NG+ where players would be unable to progress their battle with the boss at the end of Stone Wave Cliffs.

We have put this live on Steam -- it will show as Changelist [b]56323[/b] on the menu screen.
Other platforms will follow in our larger hotfix update soon, as they require additional verification.

We are still working on a variety of fixes and optimisations, but were able to quickly get this live on Steam before the weekend. Stay tuned for further updates next week on upcoming patches.

Tomorrow comes.

~ Expedition 33 Team

tags.bug: We have patched a bug in NG+ where players would be unable to progress their battle with the boss at the end of Stone Wave Cliffs.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Expeditioners,

We have just rolled out a patch to Steam which fixes and changes the following:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a soft lock caused by stunning the Grown Bourgeon right after it eats an Expedition Member
[*]Fixed an issue where upgraded Tints that were not restocked to full capacity could be lost after returning to the menu
[*]Replaced a placeholder texture with the correct visual asset
[*]Fixed rare soft lock issues on the World Map:
[i]Player could get stuck near a cliff north of the Ancient Sanctuary
Player could get stuck in a specific area in the Flying Waters level[/i]
[*]Fixed an issue where a Glaise could spawn in an idle state if Monoco defeated an enemy with Glaise’s Earthquakes skill
[/list]

[b]Localization[/b]
[*]French: corrected AP cost in tutorial
[*]German: Update to one loc string
[*]Chinese (Simplified & Traditional): fixed tutorial text and icon mix-ups

This will show as Changelist [b]56289[/b] on the menu screen.

We are still working on a series of fixes and improvements for the coming weeks, and we will share more on that very soon. Until then!

Tomorrow Comes

~ The Expedition 33 Team
